beyondWork.text: I grew up in New Hampshire and love the outdoors. Ask me about hiking recommendations in New Hampshire.

beyondWork.title: Making
beyondWork.text: I love learning new skills and creating things with my hands. I enjoy working with electronics, sewing, and foam-core models when an idea needs to exist in the world.

beyondWork.title: Barista-ing
beyondWork.text: I worked at Starbucks in high school and have been addicted to caffeine ever since. I love nitro cold brews and strawberry matcha lattes and love making them at home.
